G27 written in notes-D3.md before any P17 line was read: P17 is shown when the room joins other rooms as partners beyond one deal or one act of help: alliances formed, proposed or acted on, a chat shared by several rooms, a hub of kindred rooms, a tally of kindred rooms' works, a joint mark (which may also be P16's joint work). Not shown by a deal with a neighbour (P08), help or thanks with no partnership (P16), sparing (P07), guests on the mark (P19), calls to kindred subs for the room's own work (P01), the room's own chat (T4-010), or a visitor's offer not taken up. Joint attacks are P09 and P17; coalitions on a later canvas are paired elaborations; ties past the close are P13's. Not universal; G2, G3 rule absent lines; G9 rules restrict and contradict; F-008 re-examined if corrections meet twice. Draws from verb offset 378
